summary_source_cell.label: Summary of change:
summary_source_cell.raw_value: Remarks in summary of change:Yellow-highlighted changes show the changes from endorsed draft CR R2-1801546 after RAN2#100;Green-highlighted changes capture the agreements from RAN2#101;Turquoise-highlighted changes capture the TP from R2-1803859 which is the final outcome of email discussion '[NR-AH1801#5][NR UP/MAC] Repetition aspects';Gray-highlighted changes capture the TP from R2-1803873 which is the final outcome of email discussion '[101#30][NR UP/MAC]: TP for TS 38.321 on SR and BSR triggering and cancellation mechanisms'.General:- For the multiplication, '*' is replaced with '×' according to the drafting rules as specified in TR 21.801;- 'serving cell' is replaced with 'Serving Cell';- 'ConfiguredGrantTimer' is replaced with 'configuredGrantTimer';- 'Default-DL-BWP' is replaced with 'default-DL-BWP';- 'BWP-InactivityTimer' is replaced with 'bwp-InactivityTimer';- 'powerRampingStep' is replaced with 'preamblePowerRampingStep';- 'preamble' or 'random access preamble' is replaced with 'Random Access Preamble';- 'SS block' is replaced with 'SSB';- 'PRACH resource' is replaced with 'PRACH occasion';- The names of parameters are aligned with TS 38.331;- Also pure editorial corrections (e.g. to update subscript/ superscript).Subclause 3.1:- Definitions for Active Time and DRX cycle are added;- NOTE is added to clarify the behaviors on the timers;- Definition for SpCell is updated (i.e. always activated).Subclause 3.2:- Redundant abbreviations (e.g. RNTI, PUCCH, PUSCH, and SRS) are cleaned up.Subclause 4.2.2:- The description for when a SCell is added is amended to include that the SpCell has a RACH;- The description for the number transport channel and how they map is added for the case when no SCell;- The number of MAC entities is clarified to cover the 2x bearer case (i.e. PDCP in SN and RLC/MAC/PHY in MN). That is, SCG is not configured if only 2x bearers are configured at the SN;- It is clarified that two MAC entities operate independently in case of DC unless otherwise specified.Subclause 4.4:- In demultiplexing, 'from' is replaced with 'to'.Subclause 5.1.1:- Descriptions of rsrp-ThresholdSSB, csirs-Threshold, and sul-RSRP-Threshold are split and corrected;- In the list of parameters for the preamble index, 'in each group' is removed which is incorrect;- Random access Resources for SI request is corrected by adding ' and/or PRACH occasions' (i.e. time/frequency resources);- For ra-ResponseWindow, '(SpCell only) are added;- 'the MAC entity' is replaced with 'the Serving Cell for the Random Access procedure' as SUL is configured per cell;- 'on a Serving Cell' is added to the RA initialization.- Parameter deltaPreambleMsg3 is added for ∆PREAMBLE_Msg3 in TS 38.213;- Parameter messagePowerOffsetGroupB is added;- Parameter ra-PRACH-MaskIndex is added;- Parameters for Random Access are aligned with RRC;- PCMAX,c and PCMAX,c_SUL is replaced with PCMAX,f,c according to TS 38.213;- Description on beam failure indication to trigger RA is removed since the detection is done by MAC according to subclause 5.17.Subclause 5.1.2:- 'PRACH' is replaced with 'random access' as contention-free random access procedure includes both preamble index and/or PRACH occasions (time/ frequency), which can be covered by 'contention-free Random Access Resources';- the case where no SSB with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdSSB is clarified by adding 'select any SSB';- the text is added to say that the MAC may take into account the possible occurrence of measurement gaps when determining the next available PRACH occasion;- deltaPreambleMsg3 and messagePowerOffsetGroupB are added to be aligned with TS 38.213;- the text for ra-PRACH-MaskIndex is added.Subclause 5.1.3:- 'preamble' is replaced with 'Random Access Preamble';- Constants X and Y in the RA-RNTI equation is clarified to 80 and 8, respectively;- missing 'occasion' is added.Subclause 5.1.4:- 'multiple preamble TX' text is removed since it is de-prioritized;- '1>	if notification of a reception of a PDCCH transmission is received from lower layers; and' is added for consistency in other subclauses;- 'common PRACH preamble' is replaced with 'contention-based Random Access Preamble' for the consistency;- The start time of RAR window is clarified by referrering TS 38.213;- The procedure is updated to ignore the UL grant in RAR for RA procedure in SRS-only SCell.Subclause 5.1.5:- contention resolution for contention-based Beam Failure Recovery Request Procedure is clarified (by receiving a PDCCH transmission addressed to its C-RNTI).Subclause 5.1.6:- the text is updated to not discard the contention-free Random Access Resources (i.e. preamble index and/or PRACH occasions) for beam failure recovery.Subclause 5.2:- 'among the contention-based Random Access Preamble' is added as RA preamble can be selected by the MAC entity even for the contention-free RA (based on SSB/CSI-RS) in NR;- 'between TAGs of the MAC entity ' is added, and 'the UE can handled' is removed for better readability.Subclause 5.3.1:- 'this slot' for HARQ process ID calcualtion is replaced with 'the slot where the DL transmission starts' for better clarity;- A condition that dynamic assignment takes precedence over configured scheduling is added (i.e. configured DL assignment is delivered only if there is no overlap in time)..Subclauses 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.2.2:- From 'one or more TBs', 'more' is replaced with 'two' as up to two TBs are supported in Rel-15 NR;- Repetition aspects are captured to be aligned with TS 38.214.Subclause 5.4.1:- 'this symbol' for HARQ process ID calcualtion is replaced with 'the first symbol of a UL transmission' for better clarity (according to the NOTE 2:	CURRENT_symbol refers to the symbol index of the first transmission of a repetition bundle that takes place.);- the procedure is updated to start or restart the configuredGrantTimer when the PDCCH is received (also for the C-RNTI case);- The condition (as in NOTE) that dynamic grant takes precedence over configured scheduling is changed to the normative text (i.e. configured UL grant is delivered only if there is no overlap in time, and the NOTE is removed);- 'transmission' is updated to 'transmission occasion' in NOTE 1;- description for the configrued HARQ process ID is added as a NOTE 2.Subclause 5.4.2.1:- From 'the HARQ process(es)', '(es)' is removed since only one TB is supported for uplink in Rel-15;- ' (i.e. retransmission)' is added after 'else' condition for the comprehensible description;- 'or the uplink grant is a configured uplink grant' is removed;- For the (re)start of the configuredGrantTimer, condition for the C-RNTI case (when HARQ process ID is shared with a configured grant) is added;- Repetition aspects are captured to be aligned with TS 38.214.Subclause 5.4.2.2:- Repetition aspects are captured to be aligned with TS 38.214.Subclause 5.4.3.1.1:- The variable Bj (in Italic) is added- The procedures about maintenance of Bj is converted to a numbered list.Subclause 5.4.3.1.3:- The procedures about handling of multiple grants is moved to this subclause;- additional condition of 'aperiodic CSI' to not generate a MAC PDU is addedSubclause 5.4.4:- Optional behavior to stop ongoing RA for the BSR when BSR (or corresponding data) is included in the MAC PDU is specified;- The text is updated to trigger (or not) SR based on grant type and LCP restrictions configured for the LCH triggering the SR (for parallel SR triggering in the special ‘URLLC’ case).Subclause 5.4.5:- The text is updated to if more than one LCG has data available for transmission when the MAC PDU containing the BSR is to be transmittedbuilt' to be aligned with RAN2 agreement (for both regular/periodic and padding);- 'by the time' is removed (which was copied from LTE text);- The following redundant text is removed: 'The MAC entity shall transmit at most one BSR in one MAC PDU. Padding BSR shall not be included when the MAC PDU contains a Regular or Periodic BSR.';- The text is updated to trigger (or not) SR based on grant type and LCP restrictions configured for the LCH triggering the SR (for parallel SR triggering in the special ‘URLLC’ case).Subclause 5.4.6:- 'of the PCell' is added for the Single Entry PHR format case;- '3>	obtain the value for the corresponding PCMAX,c field from the physical layer;' is added as PCMAX,c is also required for the Single Entry PHR format in NR.Subclause 5.7:- RNTIs which the MAC entity needs to monitor during Active Time are added;- DL/UL HARQ RTT Timers is started regardless of whether the MAC entity is in Active Time (i.e. network does not have to configure SPS/GF on drx-onDurationTimer is running);- ' among the contention-based Random Access Preamble' is added to clarify that it is fo the contenion-based RA;- The transmission of SRS is clarified;- cqi-Mask is added for sharing PUCCH resources among UEs;- It is clarfied that the MAC entity is not required to monitor incomplete PDCCH occasion (i.e. the Active Time starts/stops according to the configured values without considering PDCCH occasion).Subclause 5.8.1:- The parameter 'nrofHARQ-Processes' is added according to the agreement;- 'downlink' is added for the consistency;- The equation for the Nth DL assignment has been corrected by adding '× numberOfSlotsPerFrame': modulo should be performed for all slots;- the start_time is clarified to the first transmission of PDSCH.Subclause 5.8.2:- The equation for the Nth UL grant has been corrected by adding '× numberOfSlotsPerFrame × numberOfSymbolsPerSlot': modulo should be performed for all symbols;- Missing 'confirmation' is added;- the start_time is clarified to the first transmission of PUSCH;- Missing RRC parameter timeDomainAllocation is added, and the equation for the Nth uplink grant is corrected by addding S (to provide the symbol offset).Subclause 5.9:- Subclause number for the MAC CE is corrected;- Reference (i.e. TS 38.213) is added to clarify the delay for activating and deactivating SCells;- Upon deactivation of a SCell, the bandwidthPartInactivityTimer associated with the deactivated SCell is stopped;- The sCellDeactivationTimer is restarted, if MAC PDU is transmitted in a configured uplink grant or received in a configured downlink assignment.Subclause 5.10:- Subclause number for the MAC CE is corrected;- LCP paramter allowedServingCells is not applied to the logical channels of the DRB if the duplication for the DRB is deactivated.Subclause 5.12:- The ra-PreambleIndex is replaced with 'contention-free Random Access Resources' to cover ra-PRACH-MaskIndex.Subclause 5.14:- UE behaviors during measurement gap is clarified.Subclause 5.15:- Reference (i.e. TS 38.213) for other requirements are added at the beginning of the subclause;- The bandwidthPartInactivityTimer is (re-)started, if MAC PDU is transmitted in a configured uplink grant or received in a configured downlink assignment;- The bandwidthPartInactivityTimer is also restarted upon reception of UL grant for FDD;- The bandwidthPartInactivityTimer does not start/re-start when a DCI is received while RA procedure is ongoing associated with this Serving Cell;- If the random access procedure is initiated on SCell (other than PSCell), MAC entity stops the bandwidthPartInactivityTimer of SCell and SpCell. If the random access procedure is initiated on SpCell, MAC entity stops the bandwidthPartInactivityTimer associated with SpCell;- BWP switching is also controlled by the bandwidthPartInactivityTimer;- Procedure for BWP switching upon reception of PDCCH is added;- It is clarified that the bandwidthPartInactivityTimer is (re)started when PDCCH is addressed to C-RNTI/CS-RNTI. Also, the bandwidthPartInactivityTimer is (re)started for Msg2/Msg4 if it results successful RA completion;- SRS transmission on activated/deactivated BWP is clarified;- It is clarified that bandwidthPartInactivityTimer is per BWP (not serving cell).Subclause 5.16:- The meaning of 'SUL switch' is clarified.Subclause 5.17:- Parameters preambleReceivedTargetPower, preamblePowerRampingStep, preambleTxMax, and ra-ResponseWindow are added for BFR request procedure;- Unncessary timer beamFailureRecoveryTimer is removed.Subclause 6.1.3.1:- The table value is shifted to remove duplicated values, and the last value is changed to 'Reserved'.Subclause 6.1.3.8:- In the Figure 6.1.3.8, 'PCMAX,c 1' is replaced with 'PCMAX,c'.Subclause 6.1.3.10:- It is specified that cross-CG (de)activation in DC is not allowed (by adding 'for the MAC entity').Subclause 6.1.3.11:- 'indication' is replaced with 'indicate';- R bit is replaced with 'D0' to support up to 8 DRBs for the duplication.Subclause 6.2.3:- UL grant in RAR is extended to 25 bits according to the RAN1 LS R2-1804048.Subclause 7.1:- Missing RAN1-specific RNTI (and also abbreviations to subclause 3.1) are added;- Table 7.1-2: RNTI usage is added for the comprehensiveness.Subclause 7.3 for DELTA_PREAMBLE values is newly added.Subclause 7.4 for PRACH Mask Index values values is newly added (without contents). The contents of the subclause will be filled out after RAN2 concludes the detailed values of PRACH Mask Index (subject to RAN2 email discussion '[101#69][NR UP/MAC] PRACH table').
